description: The plot titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3" illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8. The plot features three lines: a dashed blue line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate with an average value of 0.003, a dotted orange line representing the sparsity ratio after the gate with an average value of 0.126, and a dash-dot green line representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate with an average value of 0.080. The blue line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.003 and remains relatively flat across the layers. The orange line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.126 and shows a slight decline as the layers increase. The green line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.080 and remains relatively flat, with a slight increase towards the end of the plot.
